messages:
Maya: ACME SI wants a Marketplace private-offer: 12mo commit + hardware rebate + co-marketing pool. Need agreement on escrow mechanics and renewal protections.

AJ (sales): They prefer prepaid commit. Will the rebate be a cash payout or account credit? Marketplace prefers credit SKUs.

ACME_SI: Credit is fine for service consumption; hardware rebate should be invoiced as cash post-shipment. Co-marketing needs milestones (demo, case study, announce).

Devon (product): We'll create a private SKU with three utilization tiers. Question re: carryover of unused prepaid commit? Product leans no carryover.

Lina (finance): No carryover. Monthly true-up against prepaid credit. $250k co-marketing should be restricted liability until released.

Nate (legal): We'll require clawback clauses for co-marketing if milestones not met and define "announce" and approval windows. Recommend usage = Redwood billed units.

ops-bot: Note: Marketplace supports private SKUs and discounts. No native escrow for marketing funds; ops suggests external accrual with milestone PDFs triggering manual payout.

Maya: Draft terms summary: 12mo prepaid $1.2M credit; utilization tiers: <70% no rebate, 70-89% 25% renewal credit, >=90% 50% renewal credit; $250k co-marketing tracked off-platform, 3 tranches on milestones; $200k hardware rebate payable after month 6 if >=60% utilization; fallback to list-minus-10% if utilization <60%. Please :thumbsup: or flag.

AJ (sales): Ack, will draft Partner Portal private offer entry.

ACME_SI: Ack, we'll confirm milestone wording (case study approval window) by Thu.

Maya: I'll assemble a one-page term-sheet pending legal + finance inputs.
